_comment: Shared fixture for the ONE convergence computation that exists twice.
are the same three functions written twice, and `_converging`'s docstring
asserts they mirror each other exactly. They did not: the TS side filtered
profile entries to `w > 0`, so two parties who both OPPOSE the same thing
had their profiles emptied and disappeared from the pane while scoring +1
in the query bar, and any mixed profile lost its negative half and
A docstring claiming two implementations agree is how they came to
disagree. This file is the claim, in numbers, and both suites assert
against it. Add a case here before changing either implementation.

profiles.name: a plain positive profile passes through
negatives are KEPT — opposition is half the signal
an entry that cancelled to zero is dropped, not kept as weak
a profile that is all zeros is no profile at all
an empty map is no profile

cosines.name: both SERVE the same interest — allies
both OPPOSE the same interest — they do agree
one serves, one opposes — adversaries, and the sign says so
a mixed profile keeps BOTH halves in the dot product
dropping the negative half would have scored this 1.0
an empty profile yields zero rather than a division

distance_penalties.name: no path at all is the STRONGEST form
six hops keeps almost all of it
